learner_operation: Read the three indicated coordinates, evaluate f(x,y) with signs/powers/denominators, and select the diagram whose local segment slopes match. Algebraic simplifications such as y squared preserving sign under y reversal remain part of this skill.

fixed_features.feature: Three isolated points and one of five image-radio diagrams
fixed_features.justification: All seven exercise banks use this response shape; e-8505 models three substitutions and local segments. Preserves easy workload.

fixed_features.feature: Finite defined correct slopes, distinct coordinates and common equal axis scale
fixed_features.justification: A local dy/dx value must exist to be sketched; denominator x cannot vanish for the rational-square family. Equal scaling is necessary for accurate angles.

fixed_features.feature: Six observed equation families; small arithmetic domain
fixed_features.justification: The source spans bilinear, quadratic-linear, rational-square, difference-of-squares, affine-fraction and affine forms. Bounded small values preserve substitution workload; no integration or new operators needed.

fixed_features.feature: Original complete banks retained as explicit source replay profiles
fixed_features.justification: Preserves the observed source diagrams, including vertical distractors. Default authored banks do not depend on those fixed source answer arrangements.

counterfactuals.change: Within each of six fixed accepted banks, hold all points, image pixels and raw bank order fixed; change displayed coefficients to each of the five cases.
counterfactuals.expected: Correct geometry must change to the matching case; prompt and three worked substitutions follow the equation. Previous correct geometry must be rejected for the new equation.
counterfactuals.observed: All 30 roles unique and correct by independent visible-equation arithmetic; all-choice native grading confirms old-choice rejection. Actual UI renders all 30 equations and their correct diagrams; postdelivery native grading and role-presence checks pass.
counterfactuals.justification: e-8505 and lesson 31618 require substitution into the displayed right-hand side, so coefficients are relevant evidence rather than fixed source-example roles.

counterfactuals.change: Hold equation and five coefficient cases fixed; move only first target from (1,-1) to (4,4).
counterfactuals.expected: Prompt diagrams move that center, its first slope changes from -3 to 14, and the other two remain -6,-1; solution and grader follow the changed geometry.
counterfactuals.observed: Exact arithmetic/endpoint checks confirm the change, actual UI question 46 displays it, and all five radio choices grade as expected. Equation text stays fixed because targets are indicated by diagrams.
counterfactuals.justification: The source method substitutes the coordinates at the indicated target points. Their exact identities are incidental, whereas their coordinates determine the slope.

counterfactuals.change: Change seed to reorder the same equation and five image choices without changing mathematical content.
counterfactuals.expected: Preserve correct geometry, equation and explanation; learner selection follows image identity rather than position.
counterfactuals.observed: Correct PNG and complete problem/solution strings preserved; raw option order differs. Actual UI renders the same task (question 45), native grader accepts the same correct image, and deduplication correctly collapses this duplicate without losing an answer role.
counterfactuals.justification: No source equation or coordinate depends on choice order. The response is the slope diagram, not an incidental label or position.
